prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text:
We write on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped at an intersection, preparing to turn left, when the other vehicle struck the driver's side of the car. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene support our client's account that the force of the impact was substantial and that the at-fault driver failed to yield the right of way.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a serious knee injury. Medical records document torn ligaments and ongoing pain, swelling, and limited mobility. Our client has undergone physical therapy and has been advised that further treatment may be necessary. Time away from work has also reduced our client's income during recovery.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's negligence caused the crash, and there is no reasonable basis to dispute fault. We are prepared to resolve this claim without litigation, but only if your company responds promptly and in good faith.

Our client will accept the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.

Please direct all future correspondence regarding this matter to our office.
